title: Measure mid-task cuts and hand off at verified work boundaries
body:
Outcome: KRN measures how often compaction or a handoff cuts a session mid-task, and the gauge/handoff advise a handoff at the next verified unit boundary (around half the window) so the handoff file replaces the compaction summary. Source: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/continuity-research/rss-patterns.md (catnap pattern: 0/129 mid-task cuts vs 78/82 default). Feed into t-1tnpz1d synthesis.
Proof: a script prints the mid-task cut rate from transcripts; a test shows the advisory fires at a boundary, not mid-step.
